# Controls

This page lists each hook, guard, cap, and notice of claudetto.
Each row names the incident that the control exists for and the condition that removes it.
A row with `none recorded` has no evidence in the repository, so it is a candidate for removal.

| Slice | Control | Incident | Remove When |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `claudetto/advise` | `advise tool` | none recorded | The built-in advisor gives the user the control of the model and the bounds. |
| `claudetto/advise` | `advise caps` | none recorded | The user drops the tool. |
| `claudetto/decide` | `AskUserQuestion pick` | The user had to answer a choice that the project or Jev settles (trim design, decision 9). | Claude settles such a choice from the project with no hook. |
| `claudetto/goal` | `goal loop` | The built-in evaluator reads only the conversation, so it cannot run a check (trim design). | The built-in `/goal` runs checks. |
| `claudetto/goal` | `goal stop` | none recorded | The built-in `/goal` has the same stops. |
| `claudetto/goal` | `ProposeGoal deny` | none recorded | The built-in `/goal` is removed. |
| `claudetto/ground` | `source check` | Claude wrote a number, a `file:line` reference, or a convention (`npx` in a `bun` project) with no source (trim design, step 9). | Claude cites only sources that exist, shown by a replay with no false claim. |
| `claudetto/guard` | `print deny` | A `Bash` print of a file gave the text again, and only `Read` gets the short stub on a second read (trim design, steps table). | Claude Code gives the short stub for a `Bash` print too. |
| `claudetto/handoff` | `compact answer` | A compaction costs much and loses the state of the work (trim design, decision 6). | Claude Code compaction keeps the state at the same cost. |
| `claudetto/handoff` | `second compaction update` | The first handoff `H1` stayed inside `H2` at a second compaction (commit `9914887a`, D46). | The compact answer is removed. |
| `claudetto/handoff` | `session start` | none recorded | The compact answer is removed. |
| `claudetto/handoff` | `/handoff command` | none recorded | Claude Code has a command that compacts to a handoff. |
| `claudetto/prompt` | `lean_body text` | The built-in prompts are bad (the user, trim decision 3). | Claude Code ships a short prompt that needs no tailor. |
| `claudetto/prompt` | `other hooks` | none recorded | Claude Code has a setting for each cut. |
| `claudetto/sembr` | `sentence split` | none recorded | Claude keeps one sentence on each line with no hook. |
| `claudetto-browser/search` | `CloakBrowser search` | The default browser search took about 7 seconds and each search engine blocked it (`CHANGELOG.md`). | A search engine serves a browser search with no block. |
| `claudetto-browser/search` | `search permission gate` | none recorded | The mod API runs the `WebSearch` permission rules before this hook. |
| `claudetto-codegraph/graph` | `sync at session start` | none recorded | `codegraph` syncs its own index. |
| `claudetto-codegraph/graph` | `sync after an edit` | none recorded | `codegraph` syncs its own index. |
| `claudetto-codegraph/graph` | `sync after git` | none recorded | `codegraph` syncs its own index. |
